mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL trend (month-over-month) indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL shows a rising trend (month-over-month increase), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market that may lead to wage pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 3.5%, SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an impending recession, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS falls, SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, elevated housing starts (HOUST) indicate overbuilding and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, high HOUST (above 1300) is followed by positive 20d SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 105.0, SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of falling FEDFUNDS, SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising RSAFS level (monthly) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS shows a rising trend, SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising PAYEMS level (monthly) indicates strong labor market conditions, which boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS shows a rising trend, SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
